spans.s:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Material, solid.
2 Coarse, gross.
3

Compact.
4

Hard, firm.
5 Full, plump.
6

Impenetrable.
7

Viscid, thick, inspissated.
8 Deep, (as sound.)
9 Very, much.
10 Auspicious, fortunate.
11 A Permanent, eternal.
m. (-नः)
1 A cloud.
2 An iron club.
3 The body.
4 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
5 A number, an assemblage or quantity.
6 Extension, diffusion.
7

Hardness.
8

Solidity, substance, matter.
9 The cube of a number, (in arithmetic.)
10 A solid, (in geometry.)
11

Phlegm.
12

Talc.
n. (-नं)
1 A cymbal, a bell, a Gong, &c. any brazen or composite metallic instrument, which is struck as a clock, &c.
2 A mode of dancing, neither quick nor slow.
3

Iron.
4

Skin, rind, bark, &c.
E.
हन to strike or be struck, affix अप्, and ह changed to घ.

m. (-फः)
Hail.
E.
घन a cloud, and कफ phlegm.

m. (-लः)
The rainy season.
E.
घन a cloud, and काल time.

m. (-कः)
An alloy of gold and silver.

m. (-घः)
A gathering of dark clouds.
E.
घन thick, close, घनौघ cumulus.

m. (-यः)
A collection of clouds, cumulus.
E.
घन, and चय a heap.

m. (-लः)
A quantity of mire, a slough.
E.
घन much, a heap, and जम्बाल mud.

n. (-लं)
A gathering of clouds.
E.
घन, and जाल multitude.

f. (-ला)
Lightning, a flash of lightning.
E.
घन a cloud, and ज्वाला flame.

m. (-लः)
A bird: see घनतोल.

n. (-रं)
1 The darkness of clouds.
2 Great darkness.
E.
घन, and तिमिर dark.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Firmness, compactness.
2 Thickness, coarseness, solidity.
E.
त्व added to घन; also with तल्, घनता.

m. (-लः)
The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)
E.
घन a cloud, and तुल to be equal, affix घञ्; who soars to the clouds in the rainy season, which, according to the fable, is the only time when he gets water to drink; some books have घनताल from ताल tune, or sound; whose music is (from) the clouds.

mfn. (-निः-निः-नि)
Roaring, who or what makes such a sound.
m. (-निः)
1 A deep and loud tone, a roar.
2 The muttering of thunder clouds.
E.
घन, and ध्वनि sound.

m. (-भिः)
Smoke.
E.
घन a cloud, and नाभि the navel or centre; smoke being supposed to be a principal ingredient in clouds.

m. (-रः)
Thick falling frost or snow.
E.
घन, and नीहार hoar frost.

f. (-वी)
The sky.
E.
घन a cloud, and पदवी station.

m. (-रः)
A firm breast.
E.
घन, and पयोधर the female breast.

m. (-बः)
A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga): see शोमाञ्जन.
E.
घन abundance, and पल्लव a shoot or sprout.

m. (-ण्डः)
A peacock.
E.
घन a cloud, and पाषण्ड a sectary; this bird is supposed to delight in cloudy and rainy weather.

n. (-लं)
The contents of a solid, (in Geometry.)
E.
घन, and फल fruit.

n. (-लं)
Cube root, (in Arithmetic.)
E.
घन, and मूल root.

m. (-वः)
The roaring of clouds, thunder.
E.
घन, and रव sound.

mn. (-सः-सं)
Water.
m. (-स)
1

Camphor.
2

Extract, decoction, &c.
3 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.)
4 Thick or inspissated juice.
E.
घन a cloud or a heap, and रस juice, essence.

n. (-र्त्म)
The sky.
E.
घन, and वर्त्मन् path.

f. (-का)
Lightning.
E.
घन a cloud, and वल्लिका a creeper.

f. (-ल्ली)
Lightning.
E.
चन, and वल्ली a creeper.

m. (-तः)
One of the regions of hell.
E.
घन much, and वात wind; the region of storm.

m. (-सः)
A pumpkin gourd.
E.
घन a long time, and वास abiding.

m. (-नः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A name of INDRA.
E.
घन a cloud, and वाहन a vehicle; who rides in the clouds.

f. (-थिः)
A line of clouds.
E.
घन, and वीथि a row.

m. (ब्दः)
The noise of clouds, thunder.
E.
घन, and शब्द sound.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Black, deep black, as that of heavy clouds.
m. (-मः)
1

RĀMA.
2

KṚṢṆA.
E.
घन, and श्याम black.

f. (-त्तिः)
Profound secrecy.
E.
घन impenetrable, संवृत्ति secret purpose.

m. (-नः)
Low thunder, the muttering of clouds.
E.
घन, and स्वन sound.

m. (-यः)
The rainy season.
E.
घन a cloud, समय time.

Camphor.
2

Mercury, or some peculiar form of it.
3

Water.
4

A kind of tree.
E.
घन firm, &c. and सार essence.

m. (-रः)
The rainy season.
E.
घन a cloud, and आकर a mine or place of producing.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Mischievous, cruel.
2 Even, uniform, without spaces or interstices.
m. (-नः)
1 A name of INDRA. []
2 A vicious elephant, or one in rut.
3 A rainy cloud.
4 Mutual collision.
f. (-ना)
A vegetable, (Solanum Indicum); also काकमाची.
E.
घन as above, reiterated and the final of the first made long.

m. (-यः)
The season succeeding the rains, autumn.
E.
घन a cloud, and अत्यय disappearance, departure.

n. (-न्तं)
Autumn, the end of the rains.
E.
घन a cloud, and अन्त end.

m. (-यः)
The date tree, (Elate sylvestris.)
E.
घन a cloud, and आमय sickness, pining in the rains.

m. (-लः)
A kind of potherb, (Chenopodium album): see वास्तूक.
E.
घन much, and अमल clear, clean.

n. (-म्बु^1)
Rain.
E.
घन, and अम्बु water.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Deep red.
E.
घन, and अरुण red.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Overcast, overspread with clouds.
E.
घन, and आरुद्ध obstructed.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Overcast, overspread with clouds.
E.
घन, and अवरुद्ध impeded.

m. (-यः)
Æther, the atmosphere or heaven.
E.
घन a cloud, and आश्रय asylum.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Hardened, compacted, made solid or firm.
2 Congealed, thickened.
E.
घन, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.

m. (-धिः)
A division of hell.
E.
घन viscid, and उदधि an ocean.

m. (-लः)
Hail.
E.
घन a cloud, and उपल a stone.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Clouded, overcast.
E.
घन, and उपरुद्ध obstructed.

m. (-घः)
A gathering of clouds.
E.
घन, and ओघ a heap.
